**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Full architecture/design/functionality audit of brain (feature/v2.0.0) to decide if v2 is mergeable to main and usable by other projects; then scans, an epic action plan, a design-conformance scorecard vs the 7 product premises, a mechanism comparison (judgment-day vs brain-reviewer), and prepping 1.0 release artifacts.

## Instructions (owner preferences/decisions)
- Release strategy DECIDED: cut 1.0 NOW as a controlled pilot (own repos / Sinergia); auto-update-safety does NOT block 1.0 (self-owned risk), closes in 1.1. All new work → 1.1 line. Public tag starts at 1.0, next line = 1.1 (NOT 2.1; v2.0.0 was internal branch name).
- HARD GATE before opening to EXTERNAL adopters: auto-update-safety (rollback/atomic-write, clobber-safety, corrupt-file lockout). Owner's key fear = installation → split into distribution (defer) vs self-update (gated).
- Role neutrality: C (role-as-port) now → B (reference roles) later; C is non-throwaway (B = a third implementer of C's port).
- M8 per-stage engine routing (stage→engine map) is the final form of premise #2; consciously SUPERSEDES ADR-0019.
- Do NOT self-apply status:approved or size:exception (human/maintainer only, issue #124). Merge to main + tag = owner's action.

## Discoveries (verified against code)
- 3-axis decoupling is the branch's headline feature but least finished: phantom allow-list openai/opencode/pi (now trimmed), default AGENT_PLATFORM=antigravity (not neutral), day-start.mjs hardcodes gentle-ai + personal remote (#123), 2 dead resolvers (resolveMemory, resolveHarness), no ADR (now ADR-0024).
- Memory NOT a blocker: cutover C0-C2b happened (PR#223-225 real run), engram+plainfiles n=2 real+portable+integrity. #222/#217/#247 mostly bookkeeping.
- Reviewer CRITICAL (#317, judgment-day-confirmed by 2 blind judges): prReviews returns no body → priorVerdicts always empty → anti-loop/rev-bound/board INERT in prod; tests hide it via fixture body injection; GitLab reads approvals not notes; refuter(#284) is dead code (CLI defaults /1 vs doctrine §13 /2). Security boundary IS sound (COMMENT-only, no APPROVE, deny-set fail-closed).
- Upgrade mortal-risk: no rollback, plain-copy clobber asymmetry (.gemini/CODEOWNERS/AGENTS.md/workflows), corrupt-file soft-lockout, silent downgrade schemaVersion ratchet. #180 clobber fix verified holding.
- Distribution: private git-tag github-only, first install needs manual package.json edit (no npx init/bin/postinstall), brain:adopt is S1-only.
- Design-conformance scorecard avg ~63%: strong = memory(90), evolutive-memory-in-repo(85), VCS(75); weakest = SDD stage-config(40) + reviewer(45); tokens(50) design-intent but UNMEASURED (Track G brain:metrics never built).
- judgment-day vs brain-reviewer are COMPLEMENTARY: confidence (dual consensus, kills false positives) vs flow (persistent, provider-neutral, non-authoritative). Recommend a reviewer "panel mode".
- Repo gotcha: commit-msg hook REQUIRES a #N ticket reference in every commit message.

## Accomplished
- 3 audit rounds (9 scan agents total) + judgment-day (2 judges) on the reviewer.
- Docs (in docs/inbox/ + local design-docs/ + engram): brain-v2-merge-audit.md (+§0-bis scorecard), brain-v2-epic-plan.md (M0-M8, 1.0/1.1 strategy), reviewer-mechanisms-comparison.md, MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md.
- GitHub: epic #313; #312 role-as-port; #317 reviewer CRITICAL; #314 dup-267-dir; #315 hook-dedup; #316 .env-unify; evidence comments on #305/#210/#94/#123.
- ADR-0023 role-port DRAFT in brain-drafts/ (lands M5).
- PR #318 (branch chore/v1-0-release-prep → feature/v2.0.0): ADR-0024 (G3) + allow-list trim (G4, 16/16 tests green) + KNOWN-LIMITATIONS + master plan + audit docs.

## Next Steps
- MAINTAINER: apply size:exception on PR #318 (794 lines, docs-heavy); it's the only thing making diff-size red. #305 approved so issue-link passes.
- MAINTAINER: merge #318 → then cut 1.0 = merge feature/v2.0.0 → main + tag 1.0.
- Then 1.1 line = the epic, chained PRs, order M2→M3→M4→M5→M8→M6→M7.
- M0 housekeeping: close #217/#222; #94 (branch-protection tier) is a pending human decision.

## Relevant Files
- docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md — entry point / consolidated record
- docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md — audit + 7-premise scorecard (§0-bis)
- docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md — M0-M8 epic + release strategy
- docs/inbox/reviewer-mechanisms-comparison.md — judgment-day vs brain-reviewer
- docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md — honest 1.0 pilot scope
- brain/project/decisions/adr-0024-three-axis-decoupling.md — G3 ADR
- brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md — role-port draft (M5)
- brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs — allow-list trimmed (G4); resolvers to clean up
- brain/scripts/review/ + reviewer-protocol.md — #317 CRITICAL lives here
- Engram topic keys: architecture/v2-merge-audit, v2-epic-plan, v2-conformance-scorecard, sdd-role-neutrality, per-stage-engine-routing, release-strategy-1.0; review/priorverdicts-inert-bug
